title: Anthony Russo breaks down THAT Nat and Clint scene...

author: Marvel Entertainment
description:
Co-Director Anthony Russo talks through four fan-favorite moments — Black Widow’s sacrifice, Steve Rogers using Mjolnir, the Portals scene, and “I am Iron Man” — from Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Endgame, taking viewers behind the scenes with filming anecdotes.
